chapter: Desvigne compared; Piron, Celestin and rivals
title: Ballot-box popularity contests between bands
summary: At dances people voted by dropping names in boxes for Celestin or Sam Morgan; Celestin usually won.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands

blocks.x: How was the Sam Morgan band? Was that before South Stan was popular? Or were they both about the same?

They both about the same. Both were popular band. They were so popular they used to have Ballad of Music. South Stan was playing at the old San Suor. They used to have Ballad Foxes. They used to have boxes. See at that time you didn't clap for no band. You put the name on a band on a piece of paper and drop it in a box. See? Who run the battle? Yeah. Who run the battle? See when the people come in, South Stan's box be on this side, Sam Morgan's box be on this side. And you had a sheet of paper right there. You write which band you like and just put it in a box. See now you clap for a band. Yeah. You would go by applause. But at that time you put your name, see what was the popper you put your name on. Yeah. Who'd win those contacts? South Stan, Popper's original tuxedo band. You would have the most ballots in the box. I just wonder if anybody would steal a ballot of the box. Yeah. Who'd do it over with. It was a wonderful thing. Did you give them any prize or anything when it was over or just the honor of winning? It just was the honor of winning. I just wanted to know who was the most popular. Yeah. Sometimes the count would be close. Papas out there would always win. Anything else about the old time?
